prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1019; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the body shop following a left-turn collision. The damage to the front driver-side quarter panel, bumper cover, and headlamp assembly is largely consistent with the impact described by the insured. Repairs proposed include replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, refinishing the fender, and realigning the mounting brackets. The labor hours listed match the extent of the work required, and the parts and charges on the estimate appear once each with no duplication. No prior damage to this vehicle has come to light in the records reviewed. Recommend approval of the repair plan as submitted.
